column1: # Seconds each test file (pytest suites) or tests/rust module (Rust
# integration suite) took per backend. The main and comprehensive rows are
# read from the job logs of the push run for 0cfb0d92f on 2026-11-08
# cassandra-pytest). A row of a file that run did not run keeps its earlier
# value. The cli and rust-integration rows are read from the job logs of
# the merge group run for c5fe7818 on 2026-10-30. A "-" is a value that
# was not measured. devtools/test-shards uses them only to balance
# shards: a file missing here is weighted by its test count, and a stale
# value can make one shard slower but cannot drop a test, because CI
# checks that the shards together collected every test of the whole suite
